t: The $(thing)Universal Sensor/$ is, like the name suggests, a sensor that can be used in many applications; it measures in-world conditions and outputs a $(#f00)redstone signal/$ based on those conditions.$(p)Being universal isn't free: the sensor requires $(l:base_concepts/pressure)air/$ to run (1 mL/tick) in $(ttcolor)$(t:The Constant Redstone Emitter is free to use)almost all/$ cases, and Sensors need certain $(l:base_concepts/upgrades)Upgrades/$ to run.

$(thing)万能传感器/$顾名思义，是一种可用于多种场景的传感器；它会测量世界中的各种状态，并根据这些状态输出$(#f00)红石信号/$。$(p)通用性并非没有代价：在$(ttcolor)$(t:The Constant Redstone Emitter is free to use)几乎所有/$情况下，该传感器运行都需要消耗$(l:base_concepts/pressure)空气/$（1 mL/tick），而且传感器还需要安装特定的$(l:base_concepts/upgrades)升级卡/$才能工作。

Currently there are over 15 different conditions the Sensor can measure, from being able to check whether there's a block at a certain coordinate or whether there is a Twitcher streaming. Open the GUI of the $(thing)Universal Sensor/$ to see what's available, plus descriptions.
目前，传感器可测量的条件已有 15 种以上，从检查某个坐标上是否有方块，到判断是否有 Twitch 主播正在直播。打开$(thing)万能传感器/$的 GUI 查看可用选项及其说明。

You will need to insert an $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#entity_tracker)Entity Tracker/$, $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)Dispenser/$, or $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#block_tracker)Block Tracker/$ plus $(l:tools/gps_tool)GPS Tool/$ to allow selection of the corresponding category of sensors. E.g. counting the number of entities within range requires an $(item)Entity Tracker Upgrade/$ to be installed.

你需要插入$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#entity_tracker)实体追踪器/$、$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)发射器/$或$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#block_tracker)方块追踪器/$，再加上$(l:tools/gps_tool)定位工具/$，才能选择对应类别的传感器。例如，要统计范围内的实体数量，需要安装$(item)实体追踪升级/$。

Say you have a pen full of animals and want to kill some, but only if there are enough.$(p)Add an $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#entity_tracker)Entity Tracker Upgrade/$ and enough $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#range)Range Upgrades/$ to cover the pen's size.$(p)Now, in the GUI, select the $(thing)Entity/$ button, followed by $(thing)Within Range/$, and finally enter an $(l:base_concepts/entity_filter)entity filter/$ matching your animal type (e.g. 'cow').

假设你有一个装满动物的围栏，想要杀掉其中一些，但前提是数量必须足够多。$(p)添加一个$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#entity_tracker)实体追踪升级/$，并加入足够的$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#range)范围升级/$以覆盖整个围栏的大小。$(p)然后在 GUI 中，先选择$(thing)实体/$按钮，再选择$(thing)范围内/$，最后输入一个与动物类型匹配的$(l:base_concepts/entity_filter)实体过滤器/$（例如“cow”）。
